messages.text: BL-1694 🎵 in progress — swarmforge/scripts/test/test_handoffd_role_context_clear_wiring.sh (BL-316, 2026-07-12) fails at setup on main - 'coder's initial clear never fired within 30s' - because its fake tmux (lines 110-115: log the argv, exit 0) answers `capture-pane` with nothing, and since hotfix 9237008e9f (2026-08-30, 'refuse /clear unless context fullness is known and >=75%') handoffd.bb's role-context-clear sweep reads that as fullness unknown and fail-closes (role-context-fullness-percent: 0 lines -> nil; 'no /clear if unknown'); BL-316's own feature is red with it (contextClearAllRolesSteps.js runs the shell test for scenarios 04 and 05); the fake answers capture-pane with a 400-line scrollback for the roles the cases clear, a new case and a scenario 07 prove a role whose pane reads unknown or below 75% is never cleared despite a fresh completion, and the hotfix's rule enters the durable contract it changed
